info.desc: “YAYAYI” is the debut self-titled album from hip-hop producer YAYAYI. It was released on September 30th, 2013 with the hip-hop collective H20$$$SPORTS$$$. Due to the collective's falling out, the album's Bandcamp page is no longer available, but it was uploaded to streaming services during August 2021. After collectively releasing two projects ("Demo" and "Vol. 2"), each artist part of the H20$$$SPORTS$$$ collective went on to release a solo project on the collective's Bandcamp page.
